title: revocation tree (IMT) bytes and witnesses
property: deserialize(serialize(t)) equals t (depth, keys in leaf order, root) for random trees of depth 1 to 12 (and 1 % at depth 30); any byte string deserialize accepts serialises back to exactly the same bytes (only canonical encodings are accepted), and everything else throws Error; verifyNonMembership never throws, accepts the honest witness of every non-member key, and when it accepts a witness whose root is the tree's root, the opened leaf is the tree's leaf at lowIndex and strictly brackets a key that is not in the tree

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
